SELECT ROUND(f.c0004, 6) AS eligible_meal_rate
FROM t0001 f JOIN t0002 s ON s.c0020 = f.c0021
WHERE s.c0029 = '66' AND f.c0010 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.c0010 DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.c0030 AS mailing_street, s.c0031 AS school_name
FROM t0000 t JOIN t0002 s ON s.c0020 = t.c0008
WHERE t.c0010 = 'S' AND t.c0007 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.c0007 DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT c0000 AS city FROM t0002 WHERE c0020 = '01611920113902'

SELECT s.c0031 AS school_name, s.c0026 AS phone
FROM t0000 t JOIN t0002 s ON s.c0020 = t.c0008
WHERE t.c0010 = 'S' AND s.c0044 = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
AND t.c0004 = (SELECT MAX(t2.c0004) FROM t0000 t2 JOIN t0002 s2 ON s2.c0020 = t2.c0008
               WHERE t2.c0010 = 'S' AND s2.c0044 = 'Statewide Benefit Charter')

SELECT f.c0008 AS lowest_grade
FROM t0001 f JOIN t0002 s ON s.c0020 = f.c0021
WHERE s.c0001 = '0632640' AND f.c0008 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE f.c0008 WHEN 'P' THEN -1 WHEN 'K' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(f.c0008 AS INTEGER) END
LIMIT 1

SELECT c0039 AS school_type, c0031 AS school_name, c0004 AS latitude
FROM t0002
WHERE (c0039 IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)') OR c0031 LIKE '%Middle%')
AND c0004 = (SELECT MAX(c0004) FROM t0002
             WHERE c0039 IN ('Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)', 'Junior High Schools (Public)') OR c0031 LIKE '%Middle%')

SELECT s.c0031 AS school_name, s.c0006 AS district, s.c0028 AS county, t.c0001 AS avg_writing
FROM t0000 t JOIN t0002 s ON s.c0020 = t.c0008
WHERE t.c0010 = 'S' AND s.c0042 = 'Closed' AND t.c0001 IS NOT NULL
AND t.c0001 = (SELECT MAX(t2.c0001) FROM t0000 t2 JOIN t0002 s2 ON s2.c0020 = t2.c0008
               WHERE t2.c0010 = 'S' AND s2.c0042 = 'Closed' AND t2.c0001 IS NOT NULL
               AND t2.c0001 < (SELECT MAX(t3.c0001) FROM t0000 t3 JOIN t0002 s3 ON s3.c0020 = t3.c0008
                               WHERE t3.c0010 = 'S' AND s3.c0042 = 'Closed' AND t3.c0001 IS NOT NULL))

WITH cty AS (SELECT c0028 AS county FROM t0002 WHERE c0020 = '01612590125716'),
b AS (
  SELECT f.c0009 AS county, f.c0017 AS charter,
         ROUND(f.c0018 * 100, 2) AS pf, ROUND(f.c0004 * 100, 2) AS pr,
         CASE WHEN t.c0007 IS NOT NULL AND t.c0006 IS NOT NULL AND t.c0001 IS NOT NULL
              THEN t.c0007 + t.c0006 + t.c0001 END AS sat
  FROM t0001 f
  LEFT JOIN t0000 t ON t.c0008 = f.c0021 AND t.c0010 = 'S'
  WHERE f.c0009 = (SELECT county FROM cty) AND f.c0013 > 500 AND f.c0010 < 700)
SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS num_schools, ROUND(AVG(pf), 2) AS avg_free_pct, ROUND(AVG(pr), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
       SUM(charter = 1) AS charter_schools, SUM(charter = 0) AS non_charter_schools,
       ROUND(AVG(sat), 2) AS avg_sat
FROM b GROUP BY county

SELECT s.c0000 AS city, COUNT(*) AS magnet_provision2_schools
FROM t0002 s JOIN t0001 f ON f.c0021 = s.c0020
WHERE s.c0027 = 1 AND f.c0020 IN ('Provision 2', 'Breakfast Provision 2', 'Lunch Provision 2')
GROUP BY s.c0000 ORDER BY s.c0000

SELECT s.c0031 AS school_name, s.c0013 AS street, s.c0000 AS city, s.c0034 AS state, s.c0037 AS zip
FROM t0001 f JOIN t0002 s ON s.c0020 = f.c0021
WHERE f.c0009 = 'Los Angeles'
AND f.c0000 IN ('High Schools (Public)', 'Continuation High Schools', 'High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)')
AND f.c0019 > 500
ORDER BY s.c0031
